parameters.query:
SELECT
  input.job_id AS requested_job_id,
  jobs.id AS job_id,
  jobs.topic,
  jobs.language_code,
  jobs.target_duration_seconds,
  jobs.status,
  jobs.current_stage,
  jobs.id IS NOT NULL AS job_exists,
  (
    jobs.status = 'created'
    AND jobs.current_stage = 'intake'
  ) AS eligible
FROM (
  SELECT $1::uuid AS job_id
) AS input
LEFT JOIN public.jobs
  ON jobs.id = input.job_id;

WITH input AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS job_id,
    $2::jsonb AS scenes_json
),

locked_job AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    j.id AS job_id,
    CASE j.target_duration_seconds
      WHEN 15 THEN 4
      WHEN 30 THEN 8
      WHEN 45 THEN 12
      WHEN 60 THEN 15
      ELSE NULL
    END AS expected_scene_count
  FROM public.jobs j
  JOIN input i
    ON i.job_id = j.id
  WHERE j.status = 'created'
    AND j.current_stage = 'intake'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.scenes existing_scene
      WHERE existing_scene.job_id = j.id
    )
  FOR UPDATE
),

parsed_scenes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    scene.scene_number,
    scene.narration,
    scene.visual_subject_type,
    scene.visual_description,
    scene.visual_query
  FROM input i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_to_recordset(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(i.scenes_json) = 'array'
        THEN i.scenes_json
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END
  ) AS scene (
    scene_number INTEGER,
    narration TEXT,
    visual_subject_type TEXT,
    visual_description TEXT,
    visual_query TEXT
  )
),

valid_scenes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.scene_number,
    btrim(p.narration) AS narration,
    p.visual_subject_type,
    btrim(p.visual_description)
      AS visual_description,
    btrim(p.visual_query)
      AS visual_query
  FROM parsed_scenes p
  CROSS JOIN locked_job j
  WHERE j.expected_scene_count IS NOT NULL
    AND p.scene_number BETWEEN
      1 AND j.expected_scene_count
    AND btrim(p.narration) <> ''
    AND p.visual_subject_type IN (
      'factual',
      'generic'
    )
    AND btrim(p.visual_description) <> ''
    AND btrim(p.visual_query) <> ''
    AND char_length(
      btrim(p.visual_query)
    ) <= 100
),

validation_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    j.job_id,
    j.expected_scene_count,
    count(v.scene_number)::integer
      AS valid_scene_count,
    count(
      DISTINCT v.scene_number
    )::integer
      AS distinct_scene_numbers,
    min(v.scene_number)
      AS min_scene_number,
    max(v.scene_number)
      AS max_scene_number,
    count(
      DISTINCT lower(v.visual_query)
    )::integer
      AS distinct_visual_queries
  FROM locked_job j
  LEFT JOIN valid_scenes v
    ON TRUE
  GROUP BY
    j.job_id,
    j.expected_scene_count
),

eligible_plan AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    s.job_id,
    s.expected_scene_count
  FROM validation_summary s
  JOIN input i
    ON i.job_id = s.job_id
  WHERE jsonb_typeof(i.scenes_json) = 'array'
    AND jsonb_array_length(
      i.scenes_json
    ) = s.expected_scene_count
    AND s.valid_scene_count =
      s.expected_scene_count
    AND s.distinct_scene_numbers =
      s.expected_scene_count
    AND s.min_scene_number = 1
    AND s.max_scene_number =
      s.expected_scene_count
    AND s.distinct_visual_queries =
      s.expected_scene_count
),

inserted_scenes AS (
  INSERT INTO public.scenes (
    job_id,
    scene_number,
    narration,
    visual_subject_type,
    visual_description,
    visual_query
  )
  SELECT
    e.job_id,
    v.scene_number,
    v.narration,
    v.visual_subject_type,
    v.visual_description,
    v.visual_query
  FROM eligible_plan e
  CROSS JOIN valid_scenes v
  ORDER BY v.scene_number
  RETURNING
    job_id,
    scene_number
),

insert_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    count(*)::integer
      AS inserted_scene_count
  FROM inserted_scenes
  GROUP BY job_id
),

updated_job AS (
  UPDATE public.jobs j
  SET
    status = 'processing',
    current_stage = 'script',
    last_error = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM eligible_plan e
  JOIN insert_summary inserted
    ON inserted.job_id = e.job_id
   AND inserted.inserted_scene_count =
       e.expected_scene_count
  WHERE j.id = e.job_id
  RETURNING
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.status,
    j.current_stage,
    j.updated_at
)

SELECT
  updated.job_id,
  updated.status,
  updated.current_stage,
  inserted.inserted_scene_count,
  eligible.expected_scene_count,
  updated.updated_at
FROM updated_job updated
JOIN insert_summary inserted
  ON inserted.job_id = updated.job_id
JOIN eligible_plan eligible
  ON eligible.job_id = updated.job_id;
